summary: Inmune Bio filed an 8-K to announce receipt of approximately $4.2 million in R&D cash rebates from Australia on July 30, 2026, plus $0.4 million previously received from the UK in June 2026. The combined ~$4.6 million in non-dilutive government rebates strengthen the balance sheet and extend cash runway. The press release quotes CEO David Moss. This is a routine operational financing event, not a special situation. No deal terms, board recommendations, or structural changes are involved. Nothing to watch; just a cash inflow from government incentive programs.
